title: Cozy Cafe
description: Run a cafe, restaurant, or bistro in Minecraft! Cozy Cafe adds mechanics based off food service games like Plate Up! Overcooked, and Diner Dash.
body:
# Cozy Cafe

Cozy Cafe adds mechanics based off food service games like Plate Up! Overcooked, and Diner Dash. Customize your cafe's menu and serve customers every day! Build up your reputation and attract a wider audience to make a lucrative dining experience!

## Mechanics

*   Design your menu, with each food item being either a drink, main, or dessert.
*   Manage the service of customers! Better service will result in higher tips from customers!
*   Build up a cafe in any layout you please!
*   Earn **Reputation**, which attracts more customers every day and also increases the max size of your cafe!
*   Granular configuration and data-driven menu items! This is designed for modpack makers to integrate into their own packs or to make a cooking pack centered around the mod!

## Future Updates

More mechanics planned for future updates! In the 1.1 release, certain decor blocks will raise different stats of your cafe, like increased/decreased wait times and even increased tips! There may also be a flavor and theme system, where certain bonuses can be gained from either customer taste or certain decor.

## More information

Learn all about Cozy Cafe through the [wiki](https://github.com/Chakyl/Cozy-Cafe/wiki/Mechanics)! There is also an in-depth configuration in `config\cozycafe-common.toml` to tweak things like currency drops and difficulty.
## Mod Compatibility
- [Quality Food](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/quality-food) - Higher quality increases sell value and reputation gain
- [Create Numismatics](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/numismatics) & [Create Numismatics Utils](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-numismatics-utils) - Pay directly to bank account
For the above it is reccomended to use this for the currency configuration:
```
#The item to use as a 1 denomination of currency (e.g.: minecraft:emerald)
currency_1 = "numismatics:spur"
#The item to use as a 8 denomination of currency (e.g.: minecraft:emerald)
currency_8 = "numismatics:bevel"
#The item to use as a 16 denomination of currency (e.g.: minecraft:emerald)
currency_16 = "numismatics:sprocket"
#The item to use as a 64 denomination of currency (e.g.: minecraft:diamond)
currency_64 = "numismatics:cog"
#The item to use as a 512 denomination of currency (e.g.: minecraft:emerald)
currency_512 = "numismatics:crown"
#The item to use as a 4096 denomination of currency (e.g.: minecraft:emerald)
currency_4096 = "numismatics:sun"
```
### Modded Menu Items
By default, any modded foods will be added as menu items if they're edible. Mods can also be manually configured via datapack.
